title: Grateful Dead Live at Student Center, Modesto Jr College on 1969-03-28
lineage: MSC >> Nakamichi CR7a => Korg MR-1000 >> DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo] >> Korg MR-1000 => Korg AudioGate >> WAV [24/96]

ai_review.summary: A smooth, richly tuned audience recording captures an inspired Modesto show highlighted by a soaring Dark Star > St. Stephen sequence and a powerful Other One.
ai_review.review: The recording offers crystal‑clear, well‑balanced sound with excellent azimuth handling that lets Jerry’s sharp guitar tone shine. Musically the performance is vibrant – opening with “School Girl,” delivering a classic Dark Star → St. Stephen jam, soaring through The Eleven and ending on an electrifying Other One. Minor quirks (a brief drum buzzkill) do not detract from the overall brilliance.

ai_rating.rationale: All detailed reviews are five‑star, praising both sound quality and musical execution; weighting shows (70%) and recording (30%) yields an exceptional rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Smooth, rich sound with crisp Jerry Garcia guitar; well‑handled azimuth tuning; overall great sound quality though a short drum segment is noted as a buzzkill.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Shows a natural, Fillmore‑West‑style flow with strong transitions; the set builds from upbeat openings into expansive jams and closes with an energetic encore.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Edge‑filled guitar tone with sharp attack; laid‑back vocal on Dark Star; described as playing like Black Sabbath in places.
band_member_comments.Drums: Brief 18‑second drum segment noted as a buzzkill, otherwise solid.
